title: Onboarding Hub: a day-one checklist grounded in your own docs
description: A guided first-week hub for new hires: a checklist with progress, and every step able to answer itself from your own onboarding content.
prerequisites: A Glean instance with your onboarding content indexed
For the Client Chat path: a token with the CHAT scope
For the Web SDK path: nothing beyond SSO — the browser session carries the identity
Node 20+ for the Platform path, or any static page for the Web SDK path

demoQueries.query: What should I do on my first day?
demoQueries.expectedBehavior: Returns a cited answer drawn from your own onboarding documents, and the checklist reflects steps that actually appear in them rather than a hardcoded list.

demoQueries.query: How do I set up VPN?
demoQueries.expectedBehavior: Returns a cited answer from your own IT documentation.
Returns a cited answer respecting the asker's permissions — the same question from two people with different access should not return content either of them can't see.

demoQueries.query: Ask about a step your docs don't cover
demoQueries.expectedBehavior: The hub says it has nothing on that and offers the escalation affordance, rather than inventing a plausible-sounding onboarding step.

steps.title: Pick a path
steps.description: Path A embeds Glean's chat UI with the Web SDK. Path B calls Client Chat from your backend and renders the response in your own UI.

aiPrompt: Build an Onboarding Hub following https://developers.glean.com/cookbook/onboarding-hub. Ask whether to use (A) Web SDK or (B) Client Chat. Build the checklist from the user's configured onboarding steps and keep completion state in localStorage. Each step seeds a contextual question without discarding the existing conversation. Path A uses renderChat with an explicit backend and preserves chatId across re-mounts. Path B calls POST /rest/api/v1/chat server-side with saveChat:false, parses CONTENT messages and fragment citations, retries empty output once, and escalates completed thin or uncited answers. Keep credentials server-side and verify every demo query.
llmContext: Path A uses Web SDK renderChat with SSO, an explicit backend, and chatId preservation when re-mounting with a new initialMessage. Path B uses server-side Client Chat POST /rest/api/v1/chat. Read CONTENT messages from GLEAN_AI and citations from fragment.citation.sourceDocument; keep the token server-side and set saveChat:false for verification. Build checklist steps from GLEAN_ONBOARDING_STEPS_JSON or GLEAN_ONBOARDING_STEPS_FILE. Retry empty chat output once; escalate only completed thin or uncited answers.

steps.title: Credentials
steps.description: Default SSO auth needs no configuration — the Web SDK relies on the user's existing browser session with Glean.

steps.title: Verify
steps.description: Open the printed local URL (copy steps.example.json → steps.json). Confirm the configured checklist renders, click Ask about this, and verify a cited first-day answer.

codeAssets.description: Client Chat variant — server-side API call, custom UI

steps.title: Set credentials
steps.description: Fill in GLEAN_API_TOKEN and GLEAN_SERVER_URL. Set GLEAN_ONBOARDING_STEPS_FILE or GLEAN_ONBOARDING_STEPS_JSON for your checklist. The app runs as you; there is no act-as.

steps.title: Run it
steps.description: Leaves the server running so you can try it yourself at http://localhost:3000 — stop it (Ctrl-C) before the verify step below, which starts its own instance.

steps.title: Verify
steps.description: Loads credentials from .env (same as npm start), runs the demo queries against your own onboarding docs, and asserts cited answers for first-day / VPN / PTO plus escalation for an unsupported question. Do not report this recipe as done until this passes.
